resources.string: Let locked apps open without asking while you\'re on a Wi-Fi network you trust
On. App Lock Revived itself still asks for your credential
Locking relaxes only while the screen is unlocked and the phone is connected to a trusted network. As soon as you disconnect or join another network, every app locks again.
While you\'re connected to a network you trust, your locked apps open without asking for your PIN, pattern, password or biometrics. Anyone who picks up your unlocked phone there can open them.
To recognise the network, App Lock Revived needs location access, because Android treats Wi-Fi names as location data. The name is only compared on your device and never leaves it.
The network name can\'t be read until location access is fixed
Trusted. Locked apps open without asking here
Trusted, but paused until the problem above is fixed
Saved as trusted. Turn on trusted Wi-Fi to use it
Open network: it can\'t be trusted, because anyone can create a network with the same name
Also check the router\'s hardware address (BSSID). Safer, but stops working if your router is replaced or you have several access points
Networks you trust will appear here. Connect to one and tap “Trust this network”.

App Lock Revived\'s own lock is never relaxed, and nothing is relaxed while your phone is locked. Open networks can\'t be trusted. Anyone can set up a network with the same name and the same router address, so only trust networks protected by a password you keep private.
Android only reveals the name of the connected Wi-Fi network to apps with location access.
With approximate location only, Android hides the Wi-Fi name. Switch to precise location.
App Lock Revived checks the network while other apps are open. Without “%1$s”, Android hides the Wi-Fi name from it then.
Android hides Wi-Fi names while location is turned off for the whole phone.
Android isn\'t sharing the name of this network right now, so it\'s treated as untrusted.
Until this is fixed every network is treated as untrusted and apps lock normally.
Android counts Wi-Fi network names as location data, so App Lock Revived needs precise location to see which network you\'re on. It never requests your GPS position, and nothing is sent anywhere.
App Lock Revived decides whether to lock an app while that app is on screen, so it reads the network name in the background. On the next screen, choose “%1$s”.
If the option isn\'t offered, open App Lock Revived\'s settings, go to Permissions › Location and choose “%1$s”. You can turn this off at any time; apps then simply lock normally everywhere.
Location access was denied. Open app settings to allow it.
On trusted Wi-Fi “%1$s”. Apps lock again as soon as you leave it
Let apps such as Tasker or MacroDroid lock all apps or turn protection on, once you grant them the permission
Allow automation to turn protection off
Off by default. Only enable if you trust every automation app you granted the permission to

Any app you granted the automation permission could then turn off App Lock Revived without your PIN, pattern, password or biometrics, leaving every locked app open. A bug or a compromised automation app could do the same.
Tap to copy the permission and actions

1. The automation app must request the permission below, and you must grant it (Settings › Apps › the automation app › Permissions).\n2. Send a broadcast with one of the actions below and package dev.riyadm.applock. No extras are needed.
Turning protection off only works when “Allow automation to turn protection off” is on. Commands are ignored while “Allow automation apps” is off.
Lets the app lock all apps right away and turn App Lock Revived\'s protection on, or off if you allowed that in App Lock Revived\'s settings.
